newsitem.title: USA: Transco sees Mobil Bay gas line back Friday.
newsitem.headline: Transco sees Mobil Bay gas line back Friday.

text.p: Transcontinental Pipe Line Co said Friday it expects to restore the flow of gas through its 30-inch diameter Mobile Bay natural gas pipeline some time later today.
"The line is still shut in. We're expecting it to be back later this afternoon," said company spokesman Chris Stockton.
The line was shut Thursday due to a leak in Washington County, Alabama, cutting off about 700 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of gas supplies that feed into the line from offshore fields.
The cause of the leak has not yet been determined, he said, adding repairs are now underway on a three foot section of the 104-mile pipeline.
The line, which gathers gas from fields off Mobile Bay in the U.S. Gulf, runs ashore near Coden, Ala.
Transco is a subsidiary of The Williams Cos.
